BackgroundIn coastal Kenya, high seasonal temperatures compound structural challenges that include intermittent water access, resulting in health burdens from extreme heat. BackgroundEarly-onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) impairs the health of China’s working-age population and causes substantial socioeconomic costs. This study analysed China’s 33-year EOCRC burden (1990-2023), identified trend inflection points, quantified modifiable risk-attributable burden and predicted epidemic trends to support tiered prevention strategies.

Solar irradiance decomposition models are essential for estimating direct normal irradiance and diffuse horizontal irradiance when only global horizontal irradiance measurements are available. While recent studies have increasingly relied on machine learning techniques, analytical models remain attractive because of their transparency, low computational cost, and ease of implementation. This study proposes a rational function model for the decomposition of global horizontal irradiance into its direct and diffuse components.

AbstractThe intensity, frequency and severity of drought events are projected to increase in the Mediterranean region under ongoing climate change. This may impact plant growth and survival in Mediterranean forests leading to altered ecosystem dynamics. The functional diversity of soil macrofauna may have a critical role in mitigating negative climate change effects as it determines soil structure and regulates biogeochemical cycling as well as water retention.

ABSTRACTGlobal temperatures have been rising at an unprecedented rate, leading to recurrent heatwaves with far‐reaching environmental effects. The Northwest Himalayas (NWH) of India, characterised by extensive snow cover and glaciers, are particularly sensitive to temperature increases due to amplifying cryospheric and hydrological feedbacks. This study investigates spatio‐temporal variations and long‐term trends of heatwave indices and temperature extremes across the NWH and its three major basins from 1980 to 2022.

abstract: This study presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of realistic mathematics education (RME) research from 2000 to 2025, focusing on global trends and development. abstract: AI ethics frameworks treat values such as fairness, transparency, and accountability as universal and uniformly operationalizable across contexts. abstract: Drought stress is a major abiotic factor that limits plant growth and productivity, especially in arid and semi-arid regions. This study aimed to evaluate the biochemical responses of two apple (Malus domestica Borkh.) cultivars, ‘Pink Lady’ and ‘Jeromine’, grafted onto M9 rootstock, under drought conditions in the continental climate of Karaman, Turkey. The investigation focused on key stress markers in leaves—total phenolic content (TPC), total antioxidant capacity (TAC), and proline accumulation—during the growing seasons of 2023 and 2024.
